name: Fronte Scoprimenti
original_name: フロンテ・スコプリメンティ
source:
He is an international student from Milan, Italy. He came to Japan for the first time in 7 years to meet Gaku, his childhood friend. 

Because he grew up with an overprotective older brother, he is not very good at thinking deeply or making decisions. He also lacks patience, hates schoolwork, and his grades are dismal (except for his Japanese language studies).

He is always smiling, but there is a reason for this. He is naturally timid and does not like unfamiliar places or people. He loves Gaku more than anyone else, and he is truly devoted only to him.

[Translated from [url=http://frontemagica.starfree.jp/amoluce/]official website[/url]]
